snippet.title: Mercenaries Of Vector Trailer
snippet.description:
A wireframe battlefield to the horizon, and a hundred contracts to take across it. First-person mech combat 
where every enemy you break pays for the machine you rebuild — vector arcade, forty years on.

Coming October 16
